documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Annual Sustainability Report For The Financial Year 2025-26

analysis.summary: Acutaas Chemicals Limited reported strong financial performance for Q2 FY27, driven by robust demand in the Advanced Pharmaceutical Intermediate segment and CDMO business growth. Management revised its full-year revenue growth guidance to around 30% and raised the EBITDA margin guidance to a range of 38% to 40% for FY27. Additionally, the company upgraded its CDMO revenue target to Rs 1,000 crores for FY27 and set a new target of Rs 2,000 crores by FY 2030. The company also inaugurated its South Korea plant ahead of schedule and commenced commercial revenues in the Battery Chemicals business. Acutaas Chemicals Limited reported a 42.7% year-on-year growth in Q2 FY27 revenue to ₹4,369 million, driven by strong momentum in its Pharmaceutical Intermediates business.

guidance.claim: Management revised the full-year revenue growth guidance from 25% to around 30%.
guidance.quote: Before I conclude, I would also like to revise our revenue growth guidance for current year from 25% to around 30%.

guidance.claim: Management raised the EBITDA margin guidance to between 38% and 40% for FY27.
guidance.quote: We are also raising our EBITDA margin guidance between 38%-40% range for FY '27.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the CDMO business target of Rs 1,000 crores will be achieved in FY27, one year ahead of schedule.
guidance.quote: Based on the current orders of existing as well as new CDMO contracts, we now believe we will achieve this target one year ahead of schedule. It means in FY '27, we will be achieving this Rs. 1,000 crores.

guidance.claim: Management set a new CDMO target of Rs 2,000 crores by FY 2030.
guidance.quote: It means from Rs. 1,000 crores, the new target we had set is Rs. 2,000 crore by FY 2030.

guidance.claim: Management expects to deliver 25% revenue growth for the full year with stable margins.
guidance.quote: To conclude, we have started the new financial year on a strong note and I remain confident of delivering 25% revenue growth for the full year with stable margins.

guidance.claim: The company expects full year EBITDA margins for the current financial year to be similar to FY26 levels.
guidance.quote: For current financial year, for the full year, as we guided during the commentary also, we are expecting a similar kind of margin as we had for full year FY '26.

guidance.claim: Management expects employee costs to be around INR 150 crores for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: We should typically look at around INR150 crores of employee cost for the current year.

guidance.claim: Company has guided the market towards hitting INR 1,000 crores in revenue from its CDMO business.
guidance.quote: Let's say, we have already guided the market that we would be hitting INR1,000 crores revenue from our CDMO business.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment for the Pharmaceutical Intermediate business remains robust.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand environment remains robust and whatever cost pressures we face due to geopolitical issues, we have been able to pass them on successfully.

demand_outlook.claim: In the battery chemicals industry, demand continues to exceed supply.
demand_outlook.quote: From industry point of view, demand continues to exceed supply.

demand_outlook.claim: BFC is experiencing strong order demand from U.S. customers along with new orders from Korean and Japanese customers.
demand_outlook.quote: BFC is seeing strong order demand from its U.S. customers, as well as we have started receiving orders from Korean and Japanese customers.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand environment across products remains strong with healthy RFP activity in CDMO and NCE products.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment for our products remains strong as reflected in the quarter's results. We continue to see healthy RFP activity across our CDMO and NCE products.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for battery chemicals remains exceptionally strong due to tight global supply.
demand_outlook.quote: Within Specialty Chemicals, demand for battery chemicals remain exceptionally strong.

demand_outlook.claim: AI adoption is pushing CPU demand higher, which is in turn driving memory chip demand.
demand_outlook.quote: What we are seeing is that AI is starting to push CPU demand higher and that's pulling memory chip demand up right along with it.

capex_expansion.claim: CAPEX for H1 FY27 was Rs 1,239 million.
capex_expansion.quote: CAPEX for H1 FY '27 was Rs. 1,239 million.

capex_expansion.claim: Total CAPEX for the full year is expected to be around Rs 3,000 million.
capex_expansion.quote: Furthermore, for the full year, we believe our total CAPEX would be around Rs. 3,000 million.

capex_expansion.claim: The company inaugurated its plant in South Korea ahead of schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: I am happy to say that we have inaugurated our plant in South Korea ahead of schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for Q1 FY27 stood at INR 56 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: capex for Q1 FY '27 stood at INR56 crores, out of which INR15 crores were at the Indichem site, remaining INR41 crores in ACL site, which is primarily diverted towards the battery chemical project at the Jhaghadia site.

capex_expansion.claim: Planned capex for FY27 includes around INR 50 crores for pilot plant/electrolyte spillover and INR 40 to INR 45 crores for maintenance.
capex_expansion.quote: For FY '27, capex is largely the spillover capex of electrolyte additives as well as the pilot plant capex, which is around INR50 crores and around INR40 to INR45 crores of maintenance capex, that is what the already planned capex for this year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex at the Indichem plant is expected to be completed by the end of the current quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: So this plant, we are happy to share that this is getting constructed even before the schedules and expected to get -- capex is expected to get completed by end of this quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit for the quarter reached Rs 2,715 million, representing a 59% increase year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Gross profit for the quarter was Rs. 2,715 million reflecting 59% increase compared to the same period last year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by 637 basis points year-on-year to 62.1%.
margins_costs.quote: The gross margin expanded by 637 basis point Y-o-Y to 62.1%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter was Rs 1,760 million, up 84.6% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was Rs. 1,760 million up 84.6% Y-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the quarter stood at 40.3%, up 914 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins were at 40.3% up 914 basis point Y-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for the quarter was Rs 1,231 million, up 71.4% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: PAT for the quarter was Rs. 1,231 million up 71.4% Y-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by 466 basis points year-on-year to 57.9% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: The gross margin expanded by 466 basis points Y-o-Y to 57.9%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin stood at 34.3% in Q1 FY27, representing a year-on-year increase of 973 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin were at 34.3%, up 973 basis points Y-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: Specialty Chemicals business generates around 24% margin while Pharma business generates around 36% margin.
margins_costs.quote: So with regard to margin, our Spec Chem business is having around 24% margin and Pharma business is having around 36% margin.

orders_capacity.claim: The utilization level for the Ankleshwar unit during Q2 FY27 was 30%.
orders_capacity.quote: Utilization level for Q2 FY '27 was 30%.

orders_capacity.claim: Initial commercial shipments of the third product in battery chemicals were dispatched during the last quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Initial commercial shipments of our third product were dispatched during last quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: In Q1 FY27, capacity utilization stood at 83% for Sachin unit, 23% for Ankleshwar Unit 2, and 55% for Jhagadia Unit 3.
orders_capacity.quote: For the capacity utilization for the Sachin unit, the capacity is 83%. For Unit 2 at Ankleshwar, it is 23% and at Unit 3 Jhagadia, 55% for the quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The battery chemical plant has a total capacity of 4,000 metric tons comprising 2,000 metric tons each for VC and FEC.
orders_capacity.quote: So you know that the plant, we have a capacity of 2,000 metric tons for VC and 2,000 metric tons for FEC. So it's a total 4,000 metric ton capacity and for which we are more than confident that we will be able to hit the full capacity utilization by end of 3 years.

orders_capacity.claim: Company has a signed supply contract in place for the third product in the Electrolyte Additives segment.
orders_capacity.quote: We have a signed contract in place.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash and cash equivalents were around Rs 3,009 million as on September 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net cash and cash equivalents were around Rs. 3,009 million as on 30th September 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash and cash equivalents stood at around INR 314 crores as on June 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net cash and cash equivalents were around INR314 crores as on 30th June 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital stood at 99 days for the quarter compared to 91 days in Q4 FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Our working capital for the quarter stands at 99 days versus 91 days in Q4 FY '26.

risks_headwinds.claim: A temporary pause in shipments occurred in the BFC business because a U.S. customer was acquired by another U.S.-based company.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the last quarter, our U.S. customer was acquired by another U.S.-based company. This caused a temporary pause in the shipment.

risks_headwinds.claim: The BFC business was impacted by an ownership change at a US customer.
risks_headwinds.quote: Due to change in ownership of the US customer

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced geopolitical tensions in the Gulf at the beginning of the financial year.
risks_headwinds.quote: We began the financial year on a turbulent note, driven by geopolitical tensions in the Gulf.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets achieving Rs 1,000 crores in CDMO revenue in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: It means in FY '27, we will be achieving this Rs. 1,000 crores.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets reaching Rs 2,000 crore CDMO revenue by FY 2030.
management_commitments.quote: It means from Rs. 1,000 crores, the new target we had set is Rs. 2,000 crore by FY 2030.

management_commitments.claim: New CDMO contracts received are expected to start contributing revenue from H2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are happy to share that we have received orders for new CDMO contracts which are expected to start contributing revenue from H2 FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: Production for electronic-grade chemicals is expected to start by H1 FY29.
management_commitments.quote: So maybe by H1 FY '29, we should be starting the production.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains confident of achieving 25% revenue growth for the full year with stable margins.
management_commitments.quote: To conclude, we have started the new financial year on a strong note and I remain confident of delivering 25% revenue growth for the full year with stable margins.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects revenue from four validated CDMO products to kick in starting H2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: And with regulatory approval in place, we are expecting revenue to kick in from H2 FY '27 onwards.

management_commitments.claim: Indichem plant capex construction is expected to be completed by the end of the second quarter.
management_commitments.quote: So this plant, we are happy to share that this is getting constructed even before the schedules and expected to get -- capex is expected to get completed by end of this quarter.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
